claims.text: Edge video detection wastes energy on redundant frames.
claims.poster_quote: Edge video detection wastes energy on redundant frames.

claims.text: ALBIREO skips frames adaptively without retraining or codec assumptions.
claims.poster_quote: ALBIREO skips frames adaptively without retraining or codec assumptions.

claims.paper_evidence: We present A LBIREO, a detector-agnostic, codec-free, adaptive inference framework that wraps off-the-shelf object detectors and decides when detector invocation can be safely skipped based on scene content and per-object temporal state. A LBIREO requires no detector modification or detector retraining
claims.reason: Section I. The paper introduces ALBIREO as a detector-agnostic, codec-free framework that requires no detector modification or retraining.

claims.text: Uncertainty trigger (covariance growth) outperforms CTD’s stale-reference trigger.

claims.text: Rescue handles detector flicker, crucial for maintaining AP@50.

claims.reason: Section I. The paper states that the rescue mechanism handles detector flicker and is the largest contributor to AP@50.

claims.paper_evidence: A LBIREO wraps an off-the-shelf object detector with three mechanisms, each targeting a failure mode of naive frame skipping (Section II): i) a forward-looking uncertainty trigger that gates detector invocation using per-object Kalman covariance growth, ii) a detector-flicker rescue mechanism that keeps confirmed object states alive when the detector briefly misses them, and iii) a lightweight empty-scene screen that avoids full detector calls on objectless frames.
